page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance equipped with dedicated GPU acceleration. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz, backed by 48 MB of L3 cache. Memory allocation stands at 310 GB of system RAM, providing approximately 6.46 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM.

The instance does not bundle local storage, requiring attached block storage solutions for persistent data needs. Network throughput is provisioned with a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. In synthetic and realistic performance benchmarks, the configuration demonstrates average general-purpose compute metrics across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark tests. However, it excels in cryptographic operations and multithreaded decompression, aided by instruction set extensions like VAES and AVX-512 VNNI.

In AI inference evaluations, the server achieves top-tier results on small and medium language models, delivering 90.44 tokens per second during text generation on 7B models. Because it couples a single accelerator with high system RAM and 48 vCPUs, resource density is skewed heavily toward inference rather than large-scale model training. This instance is best aligned with real-time AI inference, image and video processing, graphics rendering, and batch compression pipelines that require substantial host memory alongside dedicated GPU compute.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated server featuring 48 vCPUs, 24 physical cores, and a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 48 MB of L3 cache. It is configured with 310 GB of system RAM and a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth but offers no local storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes for all disk operations. Benchmark results place general single-core and multi-core CPU performance within average enterprise tiers, while cryptographic execution, multithreaded decompression, and image processing register in upper percentiles. Driven by the A10 GPU, the system demonstrates top-tier throughput for small and medium model LLM inference workloads. With a balanced compute-to-memory footprint and targeted GPU capacity, this server type is suitable for deep learning inference, visual computing, multimedia processing pipelines, and data-intensive batch workloads.
